description.value: Scott Hill Pizza is a local, independently owned pizza restaurant that has been serving the Newton neighbourhood of Surrey since 2006. The shop specializes in homemade pizza sauce, fresh dough, and a wide roster of specialty pies — from a classic Meat Lovers to a Butter Chicken pizza — available for pickup or local delivery. A strip-mall takeout operation with no drive-through, it is a practical hot-meal stop for cyclists passing through Surrey's Newton area.

Address and phone were sourced from the website's /contact-us and /restaurant subpages, as OSM tags contained neither. Takeout/pickup is explicitly confirmed by the site's 'Pick Up' menu section and pickup-only deals; a Vegetarian specialty pizza is listed, confirming at least one vegetarian option.
